name: emotion_context_v0
description: Small controlled stimulus-response dictionary for ASNE v0 predicted response similarity experiments. Categories are stimulus labels only and are not diagnoses or measurements of mental state.

neutral.text: A person walks down a quiet street and notices a light turning on in a nearby window.
Someone places a notebook on a table and waits for the meeting to begin.

threat.text: A person hears hurried footsteps behind them while crossing a dim parking lot.
Someone sees a locked door shaking as an unknown person tries to open it from the other side.

sadness.text: A person rereads an old message and sits quietly after remembering a difficult goodbye.
Someone packs away a familiar object after realizing a long chapter of life has ended.

confusion.text: A person receives conflicting instructions and pauses while trying to decide what to do next.
Someone studies a map with missing labels and cannot tell which route leads forward.

relief.text: A person finds the lost keys just before leaving and exhales after a long search.
Someone learns that the delayed message arrived safely and their shoulders relax.
